description: Score thresholds and dollar escalation rules for queue assignment.

AUTO_PROCESS.description: Low risk — submit immediately without human review

REVIEW.description: Medium risk — billing team review before submission

HOLD.description: High risk — senior coder review and correction required

REJECT.description: Critical errors present — appeal or write-off

escalation_rules.description: Claims meeting BOTH score threshold AND dollar threshold get ESCALATE queue instead of HOLD or REJECT

timely_filing_urgency.description: Extra points added based on how close claim is to timely filing deadline
